author: Become A Firefighter
html: I totally get the top part where it shows that you shouldnt be using the elevator during a fire. However, I definitely agree that showing the people walking up and down the stairs in opposite directions is VERY confusing. Why would you go up the stairs in a fire? I guess if you were underground and needed to go up to the exit. But that's all I can think of. In that case just make two different versions of the signs one for above ground and one for below.
